Work At-Home Equipment Solutions (WAHES) is proud of the partnership we have built with our ambassador affiliate program. It truly means the world when you have people who are excited to represent you and the brand. That's what our ambassadors do each and everyday WAHES!

SIGN UP
Complete our affiliate program registration form by clicking the link: https://af.secomapp.com/work-at-home-equipment-solutions/register

After successfully completing the form you will include completing this step and make sure you have a payout method registered with your account. If no payout method is enabled commissions for your payout processing.

You will receive a welcome email from our team within 24-hours it will contain additional information. 

QUESTIONS & ANSWERS

Q: What is the link to register for the portal or log-in..Did I lose it?

A: No worries it happens! 

Register with the portal: https://www.affiliatly.com/af-1017087/affiliate.panel?mode=register

Log in to your portal: https://www.affiliatly.com/af-1017087/affiliate.panel

Q: How do we earn commissions?

A: You earn a cash commission from any orders paid-in-full that were generated via your affiliate link provided to the WAHES website. Commissions range between 3-6% depending on the items purchased.

Q: When do we get paid on commissions?

A: Our system is automated. Once your account reaches $25 in affiliate commission you will be eligible to cash-out using one of the approved payment methods (Paypal and CashApp). Allow up to 72-hours for payment processing from the requested cash-out time.

Q: When do we receive a commission for Finance Installment plan sales?

A: All commissions on orders currently in a FIP plan will be paid out, once the installment plan has been successfully completed and paid in full. It will only appear on your portal once it's paid. Until then we will monitor this as unpaid earnings.

Additional questions? Email us: support@wahequipmentsolutions.com
